_comment: The provider base URLs a name means. This is data, not code, for two reasons: `tests/test_no_egress.py` forbids URL literals inside `proxy/`, and a destination list is something a reviewer should be able to read without reading Python. A name here is only a default — `--upstream name=url` replaces it, and nothing in the table is reachable until a route is built from it (P3B-02).
